purpose: Comparison inventory only: for each attribute our extension defines, the upstream attribute it means, if any, and the verdict. It does not reshape the extension; our attributes and names are kept.

upstream_objects_at_release.absent_note: ai_capability and ai_status exist only on the development head, not in release 1.9.0; rows cite them only in caveats.

cli_agent.treatment: since extension 0.4.0-prototype cli_agent is the extension's own object and does not extend ai_agent (Owner decision 2026-10-22); its declared name, version, uid and instance_uid correspond to ai_agent attributes and are rowed as such; ai_model, charter, uid_numeric and the framework type enum are no longer part of the model

classes.treatment: Class rows cover attributes each class declares, including the activity_id override. Base-event attributes the classes inherit unchanged appear once each as base_event.<attribute> rows marked envelope.

not_rowed: Attributes contributed by base_event's optional profiles (cloud, datetime, host, osint, record_integrity, security_control) and the datetime profile's derived _dt siblings (for example journal.capture_time_dt) are not rows: the writer enables only the datetime profile, and the _dt values render timestamp_t attributes already rowed.

class_level.caveat: OCSF 1.9.0 has no agent-execution class; projecting onto API Activity or Process Activity is a lossy reshaping, not a counterpart.
